narrative:
Holmes County has 17,529 registered voters, with 54.8% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 39.3% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 5.9%, a pronounced Republican lean of 33.4 percentage points. Baby Boomers are the largest generational cohort at 28.8% of registrants.
